What does a typical day look like? LC Liam Chen Honestly, it’s client reports. I pull numbers from three systems, paste them into a template and check every figure by hand. Ares That sounds like a lot of manual work. Roughly how many hours a day go into those reports? LC Liam Chen I’d say close to four hours a day. It’s most of my afternoon, every day. Ares Thanks, Liam. Is anyone else on your team doing the same work, or is it mostly you? LC Liam Chen Everyone on the account team does it. We each build our own version of the same report. Ares That’s helpful. It sounds like the same report gets built many times over, which is worth looking at. Customer Spectrum Control Business Electronics manufacturing Published Oct 2026 “ Ares gave us a clear view of where AI and automation could create the most value. ” — David Seymour, Head of IT, Spectrum Control The problem “When we started, Spectrum Control already had AI initiatives underway and a long list of ideas from across the business. We needed a reliable way to compare them and decide where to act first.” Discovery Ares interviewed staff from the shop floor to the senior leadership team. Each conversation focused on four goals the business had already set: improving manufacturing yield, capturing more revenue, automating core processes and making better use of people and resources. “Ares spoke confidentially with colleagues across the business and built a detailed view of how work was being done across the organisation.” Clarity After 2 weeks of conversations across the business, Ares aggregated the learnings from the whole team into one evidence-backed report. The findings were shaped from Spectrum Control's objectives and all recommendations were grounded with practical next steps. “The level of operational detail made the work useful. Recommendations were linked to real workflows, the evidence behind them, the systems involved and the decisions that needed to stay with our people. We could challenge the assumptions and understand what implementation would require.” David Seymour, Head of IT, Spectrum Control “If another leadership team asked me how to identify where AI could create operational value, I would tell them to
